purpose: Score what the fixed workshop12 checkpoints learned, one goal at a time, before any fixed/mutant adaptation branch
stop: first transition that makes the commanded goal true, or world tick 128

starts.natural_reset: 16 validation layouts x 2 phases, tick 0, empty inventory and delivery
starts.common_setup: the fixed four-action prefix from that natural reset, same 16 layouts x 2 phases

commands: all 12 canonical goals, one command per episode; the policy one-hot is the commanded goal

initial_truth_on_one_repeat.note: facility/reservation_absent is already true on every state of this grid, so this evaluation does not measure it. A zero eligible count is missing data, not a success rate.

ability_rule: success_rate_eligible uses only episodes whose commanded goal is false on the observation before the first action. Episodes that already satisfy the goal stay in already_satisfied_rate and in success_rate_all, and out of the ability rate. natural_reset and common_setup are not pooled.

aggregation.across_seeds: arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation with ddof=1
aggregation.group_mean: unweighted mean of success_rate_eligible over goals in the group whose eligible_episodes is positive
aggregation.inference: descriptive timing of ability; no significance claim and no curriculum-only claim

frozen_state: evaluation reads parameters only and must leave those parameter bytes unchanged
restore_gate: before any goal table is written, every listed checkpoint must load and two copies must produce the same next training update
completion_criterion: 15 checkpoint files, each with mode and sample for all 12 goals, plus a passing restore record for every checkpoint
out_of_scope: reading the training-end deliver_3 probe as this 12-goal table
